options.label: Fix 1–5, 7–9; drop #6
options.description: Same, but leave the skill-listing figure. 3.2k comes from the /plugins Stats view for the 13 synced skills only, while 2.6k is the whole listing measured in the prefix. They count different things, so I'd clarify that in a reply rather than change the text.

options.label: Let me read them first
options.description: Stop here. You review the threads on #1098 and tell me which to fix.

options.description: A second /rvw-pr pass over the fix commit before starting PR 2. It catches defects the fixes introduce, which the research shows is where long loops come from. It costs another pass of about 120k subagent tokens, the same as the first.

options.label: Decide in the variant PR
options.description: The RFC states both options and leaves it to the variant PR. The start conditions stay as the plan wrote them.

questions.question: #1100: P1's amendment target is wrong. P1 really conflicts with the convergence clause and the ADR-0034/0037 exit gates. How should P1 be reshaped?

options.label: Amend convergence + gates (Recommended)
options.description: P1 says honestly what it changes: in the tail, a prose must-fix finding from the closing pass is fixed with its named check and does not trigger another round. That amends ADR-0033's convergence clause and the ADR-0034/0037 exit gates for prose findings in the tail. Impact is corrected to match. A bigger change, stated openly.

options.label: Keep the gates, narrow P1
options.description: P1 changes only how prose findings mid-tail are batched: no prose-only rounds before the closing pass, which keeps all exit gates as they are. A prose finding in the closing pass still triggers a round. The saving is smaller, but no ADR-0034/0037 amendment is needed.

options.label: Drop P1 from run B
